text: The underlying mechanisms by which cold-water immersion impedes anabolism remain unclear. Given that the acute inflammatory response to resistance training is implicated in anabolic signaling (75), and given that cold-water immersion alleviates symptoms of DOMS, which is associated with induction of acute inflammation, it would be logical to speculate that the anti-inflammatory effects induced by cold-water immersion play a mechanistic role. However, research on the topic is somewhat contradictory. Peake and colleagues (67) found that cold-water immersion did not alter post-exercise levels of proinflammatory cytokines and neurotrophins, or intramuscular translocation of heat shock proteins compared to active recovery following resistance training.
